title: Auto Farm, Titanic & Rarity Filter
features:
Automate egg farming, pick up pets that match your selected rarities, and return to your own base to bank and place them.

Features:
- Auto Farm Egg with Teleport, WalkTo, and Pathfinding movement.
- Prioritize Titanic eggs when a matching one appears.
- Multi-select pet pickup rarity filter.
- Zone, egg type, weight bracket, weight, hatch luck, and size filters.
- Optional maximum estimated hits limit and target priorities.
- Auto Equip Best Pets and Auto Claim Rewards.
- Auto Buy Pickaxe, Auto Buy Trails, and Auto Upgrade Pen using Cash.
- Optional Bat Nearby Players, Anti-AFK, and movement utilities.
- Config saving/loading, autoload, themes, and config sharing.

Press K to open or close the menu. Key system required: Junkie Dev or Platoboost.
Community and support: https://discord.gg/jYctNuV93X
